events.title: Play the Nova Survivors demo at Steam Next Fest
events.summary: FREE DEMO AT STEAM NEXT FESTNova Survivors is a space horde-survival roguelite. From October 19 to 26 it is part of Steam Next Fest, and the demo is free to download from this page.What the demo includesCampaign: the first 15 levels of World 1, with the bosses of levels 5, 10 and 15.Survival: waves that keep coming, up to wave 20.A selection of the fleet, each ship with its own weapon and ultimate. events.title: Demo update: bosses change shape mid-fight
events.summary: WHAT'S NEWThey transform in front of youWhen a boss or a Castaway hits its limit it breaks apart and rebuilds itself without cutting away: new parts grow, the silhouette changes, and it comes out of the transformation with attacks you had not seen. The camera takes a second so you get a good look.Whatever worked a minute ago stops working. events.title: Demo update: the sector comes alive, and the Zephyr arrives
events.summary: WHAT'S NEW The sector is full of things Go exploring and you'll find hidden discoveries, nodes that drop scrap when you break them, and explosives you can set off on the horde. Watch where you stand: if you're inside the blast radius, it catches you too. Somewhere out there sits a guarded wreck, watched over by The Reaper, a territorial guardian that patrols its hull and won't chase you across the sector. Beat it and the loot is yours. events.title: New in-run inventory, redesigned HUD, and better on laptops
events.summary: WHAT'S NEW In-run inventory Press TAB any time (or open it from the pause menu) to see everything you're carrying: cards, artifacts, relics, evolutions, your family synergies and your real stats. Every piece has its own artwork and a frame matching its rarity, so you can read your build at a glance. Three quality presets Quality, Balanced and Performance.
